headSubject: feat(relay): Use a browser AI -- a failed build or start can ask the AI to fix it (REG-322, Manager 0.13.35)
summary: Session of 2026-11-10 (second part). (1) The final T2 run (started by the previous session) finished: all 5 gates green; handoff committed and pushed (e2dcf3fd). (2) GitHub: the owner made ScrapForAI public (MIT); no key or secret needed; Identity journeys and F6 showcase rerun green. (3) REG-322 DONE (Manager 0.13.35): Ask the AI to fix this after a failed build or a start that never answers; relay_fix.rs reads the failed runs newest log in the apps own logs folder (the page names only the app and build or start), drops Java stack frames, CLI scrubs it; proven on the REAL window with a real failing build, 20 of 20 (D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\NPDev_General__OutsideRepo\reg322-tour\tour.mjs), stored prompt read back: has the cause, no frame, no secret, no user name, no local folder. The first version sent only stack frames (seen live), fixed. (4) REG-324 DONE, found by that tour: npdev monitor ops --json printed its verdict as an indented multi-line object, the Manager reads one line at a time, so EVERY script reported exit 0 and no log: a failed build was started and the person waited minutes; Studio rebuild and the Monitor were blind too (RUN-35 had only worked around it in the AI loop). Verdict is now one JSON line without output (monitor.js appends any event carrying output, it would print the run twice); test written first and seen red. (5) REG-325 OPEN, not fixed: with an app selected in the workspace, typing a new-app request snaps Use a browser AI to change that app (workspace.js synthetic change event is handled as a user pick) and Apply then says Give the new app a name first. (6) Commits 327bdd71 (REG-324) and a5938371 (REG-322) pushed; aiKnowledge and weeklyPaperwork gates green before the push; CI 6 of 6 green on a5938371.

Optional small item with no ledger entry yet: T2.2b, the CLI preview text is English in the Manager.
